annotations.title: EUDR Polygon Geolocation & 6-Decimal Coordinate Topology Verifier

description:
[EUDR polygon geolocation & 6-decimal coordinate topology verifier. Pure calculation, read-only, side-effect free]. Verifies geographic coordinates of plots of land under Regulation (EU) 2023/1115 Article 9(1)(d), auditing mandatory 6-decimal precision, closure, coordinate bounding, and enforcing polygon requirements for plots >= 4 hectares.
Usage: Pass plot ID, declared area in hectares, and latitude/longitude coordinates to audit EUDR spatial compliance.
Returns: JSON object with { plotOfLandIdentifier: string, declaredAreaHectares: number, calculatedAreaHectares: number, geometryType: string, coordinatePrecisionCheck: object, topologyCheck: object, statutoryComplianceVerdict: string, discrepancies: array }.

coordinates.description: Coordinates array: single point for plots < 4 ha, or closed polygon vertices (first === last) for plots >= 4 ha

latitude.description: WGS84 latitude with at least 6 decimal digits of precision (-90..90)

longitude.description: WGS84 longitude with at least 6 decimal digits of precision (-180..180)

declaredAreaHectares.description: Declared surface area of the plot of land in hectares

plotOfLandIdentifier.description: Cadastral parcel identifier or internal farm plot code

name: eudr_polygon_geolocation_verifier
title: EUDR Polygon Geolocation & 6-Decimal Coordinate Topology Verifier
